mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_material (id, title, name, knowledge_point, outline, instruction, html, material_id, cover, resource, removed, create_time, creator, last_operate_time, last_operator) values (NULL, #{title}, #{name}, #{knowledgePoint}, #{outline}, #{instruction}, #{html}, #{materialId}, #{cover}, #{resource}, 0, #{createTime}, #{creator}, #{lastOperateTime}, #{lastOperator})
mapper.update: UPDATE s_material SET removed=1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, name, knowledge_point, outline, instruction, html, material_id, cover, resource, removed, create_time, creator, last_operate_time, last_operator FROM s_material WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT id, title, name, knowledge_point, outline, instruction, html, material_id, cover, resource, removed, create_time, creator, last_operate_time, last_operator FROM s_material WHERE s_material.removed=0

SELECT id, title, name, knowledge_point, outline, instruction, html, material_id, cover, resource, removed, create_time, creator, last_operate_time, last_operator FROM s_material WHERE MATCH(`name`,`knowledge_point`) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AND s_material.removed=0

SELECT s_material.id, s_material.title, s_material.name, s_material.knowledge_point, s_material.outline, s_material.instruction, s_material.html, s_material.material_id, s_material.cover, s_material.resource, s_material.removed, s_material.create_time, s_material.creator, s_material.last_operate_time, s_material.last_operator FROM s_material INNER JOIN s_material_tag ON s_material.id=s_material_tag.s_material_id WHERE s_material_tag.tag_id=#{tagId} AND s_material.removed=0
